name: Machine High Row
steps: Adjust the high-row seat so you can reach the handles above and in front of you with your feet planted.
Take both handles and let your arms extend while keeping your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles downward and back toward your ribs by driving your elbows behind you and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly back along the machine path until your lats reach a full stretch.
tips: Keep your chest in contact with the pad instead of leaning far backward as you pull.
Lead with your elbows and pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
